mapper.insert: insert into abr_crawl_site (school_id, base_url, create_time) select s.school_id, s.website, now() from abr_school s where s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and coalesce(s.website, '') <> '' and s.country in #{c} and not exists (select 1 from abr_crawl_site c where c.school_id = s.school_id)
mapper.sql: select c.site_id, c.school_id, s.school_name, s.school_name_en, s.country, c.base_url, c.status, c.sitemaps, c.crawl_delay, c.last_discover_time, c.last_discover_result, c.create_time, c.update_time, (select count(*) from abr_crawl_page p where p.site_id = c.site_id) as page_count, (select count(*) from abr_crawl_page p where p.site_id = c.site_id and p.status = 'done' and p.program_id is not null) as program_count, (select count(*) from abr_crawl_page p where p.site_id = c.site_id and p.status = 'new') as pending_count, (select count(*) from abr_crawl_page p where p.site_id = c.site_id and p.status in ('failed', 'blocked')) as problem_count from abr_crawl_site c join abr_school s on s.school_id = c.school_id
mapper.update: update abr_crawl_site set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where site_id = #{siteId}
mapper.insert: insert into abr_crawl_page (site_id, school_id, url, kind, depth, found_from, link_text, status, next_fetch_time, create_time) values (#{siteId}, #{schoolId}, #{url}, #{kind}, coalesce(#{depth}, 0), #{foundFrom}, coalesce(#{linkText}, ''), 'new', now(), now()) on conflict (url) do nothing
mapper.sql: select p.page_id, p.site_id, p.school_id, s.school_name, p.url, p.kind, p.depth, p.found_from, p.link_text, p.status, p.title, p.snapshot_id, p.content_hash, p.program_id, g.program_name_en, g.status as program_status, p.requirement_id, p.fields_found, p.result, p.fail_count, p.reason, p.fetched_time, p.next_fetch_time, p.create_time, p.update_time from abr_crawl_page p join abr_school s on s.school_id = p.school_id left join abr_program g on g.program_id = p.program_id
mapper.select:
with due as ( select p.page_id, row_number() over (partition by p.site_id order by case when p.status = 'new' then 0 else 1 end, p.next_fetch_time, p.page_id) as rn from abr_crawl_page p join abr_crawl_site c on c.site_id = p.site_id join abr_school s on s.school_id = p.school_id where c.status = '0' and p.next_fetch_time <= now() and s.country in #{x} )
join due d on d.page_id = p.page_id where d.rn <= 20 order by d.rn, p.page_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update abr_crawl_page set status = #{status}, title = coalesce(#{title}, title), snapshot_id = coalesce(#{snapshotId}, snapshot_id), content_hash = coalesce(#{contentHash}, content_hash), program_id = coalesce(#{programId}, program_id), requirement_id = coalesce(#{requirementId}, requirement_id), fields_found = coalesce(#{fieldsFound}, fields_found), result = coalesce(cast(#{result} as jsonb), result), fail_count = coalesce(#{failCount}, fail_count), reason = coalesce(#{reason}, ''), fetched_time = coalesce(#{fetchedTime}, fetched_time), next_fetch_time = #{nextFetchTime}, update_time = now() where page_id = #{pageId}
update abr_crawl_page set next_fetch_time = now(), content_hash = '', update_time = now() where page_id = #{pageId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from abr_crawl_page where site_id = #{siteId}
